entities.summary: Serhiy Dotsenko is a Russian former professional boxer who competed during 2001. As an amateur, Dotesenko represented Ukraine at the 2000 Summer Olympics and won the silver medal in the welterweight bracket, losing in the final 16-24 to Russia's Oleg Saitov.
